definitions.gloss: clerical work; office job; desk work
definitions.explanation: A job category involving administrative, clerical, or desk-based tasks such as data entry, filing, scheduling, and general office administration.

examples.japanese: {事務職|じむしょく}に{就|つ}く。
{事務職|じむしょく}の{経験|けいけん}は{三年|さんねん}あります。
examples.english: I have three years of experience in office work.

examples.japanese: {事務職|じむしょく}は{人気|にんき}が{高|たか}く、{応募者|おうぼしゃ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Office jobs are popular and attract many applicants.

notes:
USAGE:
A common job category used in job listings and career discussions. Contrasts with {営業職|えいぎょうしょく} (sales position) and {技術職|ぎじゅつしょく} (technical position).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事務職|じむしょく}に{就|つ}く (to take an office job)
- {事務職|じむしょく}を{希望|きぼう}する (to prefer an office job)
- {事務職|じむしょく}の{求人|きゅうじん} (office job openings)
- {一般|いっぱん}{事務職|じむしょく} (general clerical position)
